arxiv-2203-07285.title: Accepted to ACL 2022 Diversifying Content Generation for Commonsense Reasoning with Mixture of Knowledge Graph Experts
arxiv-2203-07285.creator: Wenhao Yu, Chenguang Zhu, Lianhui Qin,, Zhihan Zhang, Tong Zhao, Meng Jiang
arxiv-2203-07285.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Wenhao Yu, Chenguang Zhu, Lianhui Qin,, Zhihan Zhang, Tong Zhao, Meng Jiang. Generative commonsense reasoning (GCR) in natural language is to reason about the commonsense while generating coherent text. Recent years have seen a surge of interest in improving the generation quality of commonsense reasoning tasks. Nevertheless, these approaches have seldom investigated diversity in the GCR tasks, which aims to generate alternative explanations for a real-world situation or predict all possible outcomes.

arxiv-2206-03525.title: Search for Higgs boson decays into \PZ and \JPsi and for Higgs and \PZ boson decays into \JPsi or \PgU pairs in \Pp ​ \Pp \Pp\Pp collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2206-03525.description: Abstract Decays of the Higgs boson into a \PZ boson and a \JPsi or \PGyP ​ 2 ​ S \PGyP{2S} meson are searched for in four-lepton final states with the CMS detector at the LHC. A data set of proton-proton collisions corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 138 \fbinv is used.

arxiv-2302-09179.title: QCD Thermodynamics and Neutral Pion in a Uniform Magnetic Field: Finite Volume Effects
arxiv-2302-09179.creator: Prabal Adhikari, Brian C. Tiburzi
arxiv-2302-09179.description: Abstract We address finite volume effects of lattice QCD calculations in background magnetic fields. Using chiral perturbation theory at next-to-leading order, volume effects are calculated for thermodynamic quantities: the chiral condensate, pressure anisotropy, and magnetization. The neutral pion effective action in a finite volume is additionally derived.

arxiv-2303-09686.title: Effect of Haptic Assistance Strategy on Mental Engagement in Fine Motor Tasks
arxiv-2303-09686.creator: Hemanth Manjunatha a, Shrey Pareek b, Amirhossein H. Memar a, Thenkurussi Kesavadas b, Ehsan T. Esfahani a
arxiv-2303-09686.description: Abstract This study investigates the effect of haptic control strategies on a subject’s mental engagement during a fine motor handwriting rehabilitation task. The considered control strategies include an error-reduction (ER) and an error-augmentation (EA), which are tested on both dominant and non-dominant hand.

arxiv-2305-17683.title: Integrability of a globally coupled complex Riccati array: quadratic integrate-and-fire neurons, phase oscillators and all in between
arxiv-2305-17683.creator: Rok Cestnik, Erik A. Martens
arxiv-2305-17683.description: Abstract We present an exact dimensionality reduction for dynamics of an arbitrary array of globally coupled complex-valued Riccati equations. It generalizes the Watanabe-Strogatz theory [Phys. Rev. Lett. 70, 2391 (1993)] for sinusoidally coupled phase oscillators and seamlessly includes quadratic integrate-and-fire neurons as the real-valued special case.

arxiv-2402-15890.creator: Sumit Goel Wade Hann-Caruthers
arxiv-2402-15890.description: Abstract We study a multi-agent contract design problem with moral hazard. In our model, each agent exerts costly effort towards an individual task at which it may either succeed or fail, and the principal, who wishes to encourage effort, has an exclusive-use budget that it can use to reward the agents.

arxiv-2402-16936.title: Disentangled 3D Scene Generation with Layout Learning
arxiv-2402-16936.creator: Dave Epstein, Ben Poole, Ben Mildenhall, Alexei A. Efros, Aleksander Holynski
arxiv-2402-16936.description: Abstract We introduce a method to generate 3D scenes that are disentangled into their component objects. This disentanglement is unsupervised, relying only on the knowledge of a large pretrained text-to-image model. Our key insight is that objects can be discovered by finding parts of a 3D scene that, when rearranged spatially, still produce valid configurations of the same scene.

arxiv-2405-13473.title: Class-Conditional self-reward mechanism for improved Text-to-Image models
arxiv-2405-13473.creator: Safouane EL GHAZOUALI*, Arnaud GUCCIARDI, Umberto Michelucci
arxiv-2405-13473.description: Abstract Self-rewarding have emerged recently as a powerful tool in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), allowing language models to generate high-quality relevant responses by providing their own rewards during training. This innovative technique addresses the limitations of other methods that rely on human preferences.

arxiv-2501-18640.title: Divergent Emotional Patterns in Disinformation on Social Media? An Analysis of Tweets and TikToks about the DANA in Valencia
arxiv-2501-18640.creator: Iván Arcos 1 , Paolo Rosso 1,2 , Ramón Salaverría 3 1 PRHLT Research Center, Universitat Politècnica de València, Valencia, Spain 2 ValgrAI Valencian Graduate School and Research Network of Artificial Intelligence, Spain 3 School of Communication, Universidad de Navarra, Pamplona, Spain iarcgab@etsi
arxiv-2501-18640.description: Abstract This study investigates the dissemination of disinformation on social media platforms during the DANA event (DANA is a Spanish acronym for Depresión Aislada en Niveles Altos , translating to high-altitude isolated depression) that resulted in extremely heavy rainfall and devastating floods in Valencia, Spain, on October 29, 2024.

arxiv-2505-00762.title: Can planet–planet binaries survive in star-forming regions? Can planet–planet binaries survive in star-forming regions? – References 2025
arxiv-2505-00762.creator: Richard J. Parker, Simon P. Goodwin, Jessica L. Diamond
arxiv-2505-00762.description: Abstract Significant numbers of free-floating planetary-mass objects have been discovered in nearby star-forming regions by the James Webb Space Telescope, including a substantial number (42) of Jupiter Mass Binary Objects (‘JuMBOs’) in the Orion Nebula Cluster. The JuMBOs have much wider separations than other populations of substellar binaries, and their existence challenges conventional theories of substellar and planetary-mass object formation.

arxiv-2507-01774.creator: Susmita Changdar, Oleksandr Suvorov, Andrii Kuibarov, Setti Thirupathaiah, Grigoriy Shipunov, Saicharan Aswartham, Sabine Wurmehl, Iryna Kovalchuk, Klaus Koepernik, Carsten Timm, Bernd Büchner, Ion Cosma Fulga, Sergey Borisenko, Jeroen van den Brink
arxiv-2507-01774.description: Abstract Most superconducting materials are well-understood and conventional in the sense that the pairs of electrons that cause the superconductivity by their condensation have the highest possible symmetry. Famous exceptions are the enigmatic high- T_{c} cuprate superconductors Sigrist and Ueda 1991 .

arxiv-2507-22302.title: Controlling X-ray emission with optical nanostructures
arxiv-2507-22302.creator: Elina Sendonaris 1,∗ , Jamison Sloan 2 , Nicholas Rivera 3,4 , Ido Kaminer 5 , Marin Soljačić 6
arxiv-2507-22302.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Elina Sendonaris 1,∗ , Jamison Sloan 2 , Nicholas Rivera 3,4 , Ido Kaminer 5 , Marin Soljačić 6. Nonlinear processes lie at the heart of many technologies such as frequency converters and entangled photon sources. Historically, observation and manipulation of these processes, for instance through nanostructures, has been limited to optical and lower frequencies. Recently, however, second-order nonlinear processes which couple X-ray and optical photons have been observed and used to probe the electronic structure and optical response of materials.

arxiv-2509-16790.title: A facilitation-induced fluidization transition in supercooled water triggered by a few active molecules.
arxiv-2509-16790.creator: Quoc Tuan Truong, Victor Teboul
arxiv-2509-16790.description: Abstract Using an activation mechanism reproducing facilitation, a dynamic phase transition triggered by a few active molecules was recently found in a supercooled model liquid. Prompted by this finding we investigate the presence of a similar transition in supercooled water.

The two-dimensional molecular conductor κ \kappa -(BETS) 2 Mn[N(CN) 2 ] 3 has been studied because of the intriguing magnetic coupling of the molecular π \pi -electrons to the Mn 2+ ions. Utilizing X-band electron spin resonance spectroscopy we have performed comprehensive investigations of the magnetic properties, in particular on the temperature and angular dependences of the spin susceptibility, the g g -factor and the linewidth.

pmc-13039927.title: A single extinction-based treatment with N-Acetylcysteine produces long-term reduction in cocaine relapse
pmc-13039927.creator: Shihao Huang, Zhihao Song, Cuijie Shi, Dan Tao, Jing Wen, Yisi Chen, Yixiao Luo
pmc-13039927.description: Cocaine addiction is characterized by high relapse rates associated with glutamate dysregulation, presenting significant challenges for long-term treatment. N-acetylcysteine (NAC) has shown promise in preventing drug relapse by normalizing glutamate function, potentially mediated by glutamate 2/3 (mGlu2/3) receptor activation. This study investigated the therapeutic potential of NAC in reducing cocaine-seeking behavior using the self-administration model.

pmc-13054584.description: ObjectiveConventional freehand three-dimensional interstitial brachytherapy (F-3DIB) for locally advanced cervical cancer (LACC) is limited by suboptimal dose distribution and operator dependency.
